title: Attempt-bound Capsule delivery through the Context Owner
method: the install binds a late-bound delivery provider to the Context Owner; workWorkerContext(attemptId) passes THAT attempt id to the provider, which calls capsuleForConsumer with it
observed: the correct consumer (A1) receives its permitted A0 Capsule in compiled.trajectoryCapsule with origin A0, framing HISTORICAL_DATA_NOT_INSTRUCTIONS, authority READ_ONLY_INSPECTION, a serialized byte count and a 64-hex content digest; the wrong consumer (A0) receives nothing; a forged attempt id resolves to null
expectedInvariant: the model does not choose its own consumer identity, source Session or historical scope
remainingUncertainty: the origin Execution Association is a controlled fixture; the combined real-first-party-DSH + governed-delivery chain is not established
